title: Chapter 70
text: My last words with my father before the Battle of Aretia were spoken in anger, because he was sending me away for my own safety. I’m not sure I’ll ever forgive myself for that, but I like to think he forgives me . —R ECOVERED C ORRESPONDENCE OF L IEUTENANT X ADEN R IORSON TO C ADET V IOLET S ORRENGAIL
